ask.answerLead: Peak staffing is currently your highest priority.
ask.answerBody: At {location}, expected peak demand exceeds scheduled FOH capacity between {peakStart} and {peakEnd}.
ask.honestyNote: Ask RADR uses the same Findings and Prepared Actions as Control Center. It does not invent autonomy.

actions.governanceNote: Prepared for approval. External execution happens only through supported systems and organization policy.
